1.3.1ST STAGE OF LABOR:

Duration

Primigravida, 8 – 18 hours, 2nd gravida onwards 5 – 12 hours.

Latent 1st stage:

•Can be continuous or intermittent
•Contraction present along with some cervical Change that can be in either cervical position, consistency, effacement or dilatation up to 4 cm.

Established 1st stage:

Regular contraction

Progressive cervical dilatation beyond 4cm.

 

⇨Initial assessment and triage, Review.
-Women’s obstetric notes
-Risk factors
-Wishes and concerns
-Place of birth discussion
-Individualized care plan.

Examination:

Abdominal, Vaginal, FHR

- SFH

- Position - For 1 min

- Lie Bishop - immediately

- Presentation after contraction

- Palpate

maternal pulse

•PPI don’t offer routinely
•PPI offer to those who received opioids or going to have C/S.
•Drink to thirst, isotonic fluids more beneficial than water.
•Can take light diet unless received opioids or going to have C/S.
•Don’t routinely perform amniotomy + oxytocin
•Don’t offer clinical intervention if labor is progressive.

Observations during 1st Stage:

½ hourly 1 hourly 4 hourly

Contraction frequency

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

Delay in 1st stage of labor is suspected when:

•Cervical dilatation < 2cm in 4 hours.
•Descent and rotation of baby’s head is delayed
•Change in strength, duration and frequency of contraction.

 

Full assessment by knowing parity, uterine contraction, cervical dilation and rate of change, station and position of presenting part.

 

Offer support and effective pain relief

 

 

 

 

Repeat examination after 2 hours

Suspect delay if dilation < 1 cm

 

Offer amniotomy

Explain procedure

Advice that it will shorten labor by an hour.

 

 

Repeat examination after 2 hours

 

Normal progress no progress, Confirm Delay

 

Continue care and support

Protocols of Oxytocin Administrations:

•Start after discussion with women, stop whenever she wants.
•Effective analgesia i.e., epidural
•In Obstetric led units after obstetrician’s advice
•CTG
•Monitor fluid balance
•No, I/V fluid routinely except patient is not drinking or dehydrated or hypotensive
•Incremental doses not less than 30 min, till 3 – 4 contractions in 10 minutes.

Stop oxytocin:

•Contractions > 4 in 10 minutes.
•Abnormal CTG
•Women’s request.
